tier_rationale: A battery-powered digital keypad safe with a motor-driven bolt lock and a physical override key. The manufacturer's own product page states no WiFi, Bluetooth, or app functionality exists for this model, and a grantee search for 'SentrySafe' on fccid.io returns no matches for the safe manufacturer (the only 'Sentry' hits are an unrelated Bluetooth-audio company, 'Sentry Industries limited'). No intentional radiator is present, so D0 applies even though the lock itself is electronic.
the_unplug_test: There is nothing to unplug — this safe was never connected to anything. Punch the 5-digit code into the backlit keypad and the motor-driven bolts retract, exactly the same whether your internet, power grid, or SentrySafe itself is running. The lithium battery (rated 5+ years) runs the keypad and motor; if it dies, the physical override key opens the door. No app, no pairing, no account, ever.

repairability.notes: Battery is user-replaceable (external 9V terminal typical of this SentrySafe line for a dead-battery jump-start); no teardown or spare-parts source found for the keypad/motor lock assembly itself.

sources.supports: Manufacturer product page: confirms no WiFi/Bluetooth/app connectivity; digital backlit keypad with programmable 5-digit code, motor-driven lock, physical override key, UL Classified 1-hour/1700F fire rating, ETL-verified 24-hour/5-inch water protection, and current pricing.

Sibling-control check: the grantee search for 'Sentry' on fccid.io surfaces only Bluetooth audio products from an unrelated company, 'Sentry Industries limited' — not SentrySafe the safe manufacturer — supporting that SentrySafe holds no radio-equipment grants at all for this or related keypad-safe models.

open_questions: No teardown found confirming the keypad/motor assembly contains no radio component beyond the manufacturer's own marketing claim; a physical inspection would strengthen this further.
Exact current price at time of any given sale varies with SentrySafe/retailer promotions; band reflects the manufacturer's own listed range.
notes: Recorded as the dial/keypad-safe answer for the security domain. SentrySafe's whole consumer line, at the time of research, appears to be keypad-or-dial with no connected variant — unlike locks and doorbells, there is no obvious 'smart safe' sibling on the same shelf, which makes the FCC absence check less load-bearing here than for a vendor that sells both.
